acf.s030_h2:
Investing in resort real estate at
La Sagesse Collection
acf.s031_p: A premium resort apartment project on La Sagesse beach, one of Grenada's most unspoiled and picturesque beaches.
acf.s032_p: A prime location, about 30 minutes from Maurice Bishop International Airport and from central St. George's, the capital.
acf.s033_p: You invest by purchasing a real estate share in a project approved by the Government of Grenada.
acf.s034_p: Multiple generations of your family can apply for Grenadian citizenship and hold a passport with access to more than 140 countries.
acf.s035_p: Built by Range Developments, an established resort developer with a track record of delivering luxury Citizenship by Investment (CBI) projects in the Caribbean.
acf.s045_p: A real estate share in an approved resort project
acf.s053_p: The project sits on La Sagesse beach, among the most unspoiled and peaceful stretches of coast in southern Grenada.
acf.s056_p: Easy to reach, about 30 minutes from Maurice Bishop International Airport and from central St. George's, the capital.
acf.s059_p: Set between Six Senses La Sagesse and InterContinental Grenada Resort & Spa — two luxury IHG resorts built by Range Developments.
acf.s061_li: bedStudio, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments with ocean views
acf.s067_li: beach_accessPrivate path straight to the beach

acf.s070_p: Range Developments is a real estate and hospitality developer in the Caribbean.
acf.s074_p: Range Developments projects have drawn more than 1,800 investors and created about 2,500 jobs, with more than 4,200 passports issued to investor families.
acf.s077_p: Earlier Range projects include Park Hyatt St. Kitts, Cabrits Resort & Spa Kempinski Dominica, and Six Senses Grenada.
acf.s080_p: The project sits within Grenada's premium resort segment, developed for the international hospitality market and for the Citizenship by Investment program.
acf.s083_p: IMM Group has been a partner of Range Developments since 2020.
acf.s091_p: Please contact IMM Group for the latest construction progress, availability, and project documents at the time of your consultation.
acf.s092_p: Holding a real estate share in Grenada can be more than an investment with income potential and a store of value held in US dollars. A share in The La Sagesse Collection — a project approved by the Government of Grenada — also opens a route to citizenship for life for your whole family, with no residence requirement.
acf.s095_p: If you invest in a qualifying project, you can apply for Grenadian citizenship under Grenada's Citizenship by Investment program.
acf.s097_p: Grenadian citizenship is granted for life if the Government of Grenada approves your application.
acf.s099_p: Your family can be included in the same application, within the range of dependents the program allows at the time you apply.
acf.s101_p: Grenada allows dual or multiple citizenship, so you can keep your current citizenship if the laws of that country allow it.
acf.s102_li: IMM Group is the first and only company in Vietnam authorized by the Government of Grenada to market the Grenada Citizenship by Investment program
acf.s103_li: IMM Group helps prepare your application and represents your interests throughout the process.
acf.s109_li: You and your family can receive Grenadian citizenship and passports if your application is approved.
acf.s110_li: The Grenadian passport offers convenient travel access to more than 140 countries and territories, including much of Europe, the United Kingdom, China, and Hong Kong.
acf.s111_li: There is no requirement to live in Grenada to keep your citizenship.
acf.s112_li: The whole process can be completed from your country of residence.
acf.s116_li: The main applicant must be 18 or older.
acf.s117_li: You must be in good health, have no criminal record, and have enough lawfully sourced funds to make the investment.
acf.s118_li: The application goes through due diligence and background checks and is assessed by the Government of Grenada.
acf.s122_li: The projected return is about 4% a year over 5 years — roughly US$54,000 in total.
acf.s123_li: Under the project terms, the return is paid after your citizenship application is approved and you have completed 100% of the investment.
acf.s127_li: Investors receive 7 complimentary nights a year at the resort for 5 years, as set out in the project documents.
acf.s128_li: Use of the resort benefit is subject to the project's rules and operating calendar.
